title: Whole mRNA transcriptome sequencing of human monocyte-derived dendritic cells
description: The goal of this study is to analyze the transcriptome of human monocyte-derived dendritic cells (moDCs) treated with Push/Pull Immunomodulation (PPI) to investigate its tolerogenic effects. moDCs were generated from peripheral blood monocytes and treated with PPI or conventional agents. Transcriptome sequencing was conducted to elucidate molecular mechanisms associated with PPI-induced tolerogenicity.
